messages:
Omar (FinStack): Hi - onboarding hit a sudden auth 429 flood during today's deploy. first couple of requests OK, then lots of 429s. using node-sdk v2.1. auth tokens are ephemeral (~45s). any quick guidance?

Lina (CS): sorry about that. can you share a short snippet of the startup logic and whether pods start in parallel? region?

Omar (FinStack): us-west-2. k8s scaled 30 -> 80 replicas. our app calls `client.authenticate()` on start and our readiness probe calls `client.ping()` which triggers auth if token missing. snippet: `appStart().catch(()=>setTimeout(appStart,50))` - yes pretty tight.

Jun (SDK Eng): that tight retry + parallel cold starts = classic stampede on token endpoint. quick fixes: 1) stop calling auth from readiness probe, 2) add randomized start jitter (0-1000ms), 3) use exponential backoff with jitter for retries (base 200ms cap 5s).

Alex (Ops): i can also adjust deployment strategy to limit surge. want me to change maxSurge and pause the rollout?

Omar (FinStack): please limit surge while we patch. we can push a hotfix in ~15m.

Lina (CS): I opened support ticket #22777 requesting a temporary per-key rate uplift in us-west-2 for 1 hour to cover the deploy window.

support-bot: Support ticket #22777 created for account "FinStack" — temporary per-key rate uplift (1 hour) region: us-west-2.

Jun (SDK Eng): also recommend local token cache (shared tmpfile or memcached) so simultaneous inits reuse a token. we'll add a small SDK example for cold-start auth patterns to docs.

Omar (FinStack): applied jitter + backoff and disabled auth in readiness. redeploying now. will attach telemetry to ticket if any more 429s.

Alex (Ops): changed deployment to `maxSurge: 3`, rolled back aggressive probes. rollout stable so far.

Lina (CS): leaving ticket open until end of uplift window, will cancel early if green. thanks all.

Omar (FinStack): looks good — no 429s after fix. really appreciate the quick help :heart:
